data.name: Counter Spell
data.detailed_description:
Counter Spell is a fast-paced multiplayer arena spellcasting game where your voice is your weapon. Instead of clicking through a spell bar, players cast magic by speaking spell names out loud, turning every duel into a chaotic battle of timing, aim, movement, and quick reactions.

Fight against friends in physics-driven arenas built for unpredictable magical combat. Launch attacks, counter enemy spells, dodge incoming projectiles, and use the arena itself to your advantage as spells collide, objects fly, and fights quickly spiral out of control. Proximity voice chat keeps every match tense and funny, letting players hear each other shout spells, panic, bluff, and react in real time.

The game is designed around short, replayable multiplayer matches where players compete to outcast, outmaneuver, and outsmart each other. Every round challenges you to manage distance, choose the right spell for the situation, and react faster than your opponents.

Features include:

- Voice-controlled spellcasting

- Fast-paced multiplayer arena battles

- Physics-driven magical combat

- Proximity voice chat

- Spells designed for attacking, defending, countering, and disrupting opponents

- Chaotic emergent moments created by player choices, spell interactions, and arena physics

- Matches built for dueling friends and creating unpredictable multiplayer encounters

Counter Spell is for players who want a party-friendly arena shooter with a unique spellcasting twist, where shouting the right spell at the right time can be the difference between winning the duel and getting blasted across the arena.
